rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for an electrical outlet.

example.english: There’s no outlet here, so I can’t charge my computer.
example.traditional: 呢度冇插蘇，部電腦叉唔到電。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 mou5 caap3 sou1 bou6 din6 nou5 caa1 m4 dou3 din6

rows.note: Use this for an activity or means that lets someone release stress, emotions, or desires.

example.english: Playing basketball is my outlet when I’m stressed.
example.traditional: 打波係我發洩嘅渠道，心情唔好嗰陣我就去打波。
example.jyutping: daa2 bo1 hai6 ngo5 faat3 sit3 ge3 keoi4 dou6 sam1 cing4 m4 hou2 go2 zan6 ngo5 zau6 heoi3 daa2 bo1

rows.note: Use this for a vent or opening that lets air, gas, or fumes escape, rather than for an electrical outlet.

example.english: The kitchen outlet is broken, so the cooking fumes can’t get out.
example.traditional: 廚房個排氣口壞咗，啲油煙散唔出去。
example.jyutping: cyu4 fong2 go3 paai4 hei3 hau2 waai6 zo2 di1 jau4 jin1 saan3 m4 ceot1 heoi3
